guide_notes: Discover the graph vocabulary and the direction of the subsidiaryOf relationship.
Resolve the named subsidiary. The returned handle contains the selected entity under the variable subsidiary; alternative candidates are separate suggestions.
Follow subsidiaryOf outward from the subsidiary to its parent company. The new handle retains both entity variables.
Select the parent company's name. The resulting table handle contains answer values and no longer carries entity variables.
Fetch the final table. This answer fits on one page and matches the benchmark's expected rows.
